lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Can Bruno Do It? Can and Can't
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruno de Moraes Guimarães | Lesson 9 -- Can Bruno Do It?
lesson.grammar_point: can and can't for ability, for permission and for offers

listenings.text: Hi, it's Tyler. People ask me what I can do, so here is the honest answer. I can play basketball, of course. I can swim, but not very well. I can cook two things: eggs and pasta. That's all. I can't drive yet, because I am sixteen and here you need to be sixteen and a half. And I can't speak another language. I understand a little Spanish, but I can't have a conversation. Not yet. What about you? What can you do?

Good morning, everybody. Three quick rules for this week. One: you can use your phone in the hall, but you can't use it on the court. Two: you can borrow a ball from the box, but please put it back after practice. Three: if you don't understand an instruction, you can always ask me again. That is not a problem. It is never a problem. Can everybody hear me at the back? Good. Let's start.

extra_audio.text: Bruno's phone has no battery before the game. He asks a friend for a charger. The friend says he can borrow it. Bruno charges the phone in the hall. He gives the charger back after practice.
